map.节理（密度/走向/充填）统计工具。输入节理产状与密度数据，统计节理密度、优势走向: The joint statistics tool takes joint orientation and density data and reports joint density, dominant orientation, and filling, for rock mass discontinuity analysis and slope stability reference.
map.节理密度：统计测线或露头上单位长度的节理数，评岩体完整性: Joint density: count joints per unit length along scan lines or on outcrops to assess rock mass integrity
map.优势走向：对节理走向数据做统计，确定优势节理组与 Rosivo 图: Dominant orientation: statistically process joint orientation data to determine the dominant joint set and a Rosiwal plot
map.边坡参考：结合产状与充填判定控制性结构面，辅助边坡稳定分析: Slope reference: combine orientation and filling to identify the controlling discontinuity, supporting slope stability analysis
map.：算法：输入一组节理数据（如线密度 条/m、或走向角度序列），自动得数据量 n、: : algorithm: enter a set of joint data (such as linear density in joints/m or a sequence of orientation angles) and it returns the data count n, mean, median, min, max, range, variance, and standard deviation. Linear density = joint count ÷ scan line length; intact rock is often under 1 joint/m while fault zones reach 5–10 joints/m (computed locally, nothing uploaded).
map.：例：某边坡 5 条测线节理线密度（条/m）3.2, 4.0, 2.8, 5.1: : example: joint linear densities along five scan lines of 3.2, 4.0, 2.8, 5.1, 3.5 joints/m give n=5, mean=3.72 joints/m, median=3.5, standard deviation σ=0.84 joints/m, range=2.3 joints/m. A high linear density (over 3 joints/m) suggests a fractured rock mass, so the slope must be checked against multiple controlling joint sets.
